QuestInfo.name: Malicious Manager Karl
QuestInfo.0: Roly-Poly 1 at the toy factory has a lot of grievances. Go ask Roly-Poly 1 what the problems are.
QuestInfo.1: Roly-Poly 1 tells you that they cannot take the sweatshop like conditions and the mistreatment any longer. So they are planning to move forward with the strike they have been planning. Check the #rpassword#k with other Roly-Poly workers at the factory and deliver the news of the strike.
QuestInfo.2: You've delivered the message of strike to other Roly-Poly working at the toy factory.

0.0: This is slavery! I know we have a lot of orders coming in, but making us work 12 hours a day every day is too much! All without overtime pay! Two of my coworkers fainted from overwork just this month alone!
0.1: I can no longer work under these conditions, so I'm going to start a #rstrike#k . We've been talking about it for awhile, but it is SUPER important that you keep this ABSOLUTELY secret.

yes.0: The Roly-Poly workers have been planning a #bstrike#k for a long time. Now is to time to stand together. Go tell all our co-workers that tomorrow is the day we start the #bstrike#k.
yes.1: But be aware, there's a spy among us Roly-Polys that Manager Karl planted. That's why you MUST ask for the #bpassword#k before you tell anyone ANYTHING! The #bpassword#k is #e#rit might rain soon#k#n when you ask about the weather.

no.0: I can't give you any info if you're not with us.

1.0: Did you talk to the other Roly-Polys? Then you must also know who the spy is.

yes.0: What? Roly-Poly 4 is the spy? Whew, I'm glad we figured it out in time!

default.0: The #bpassword#k is #e#rit might rain soon#k#n. Be sure not to leak any information to the spy!
